Title: HTTP and APIs
Content:
Serve and call HTTP APIs, expose JSON-RPC methods and trace the whole stack. Overview The HTTP stack of Fusion is built on Apache Tomcat (server) and java.net.http (client), with a uniform request/response API and generated endpoint matchers. TIP JSON-RPC is a first-class, core feature: declare a @JsonRpc method on any bean and it is served over HTTP with full OpenRPC discovery - no routing or serialization plumbing to write. It is the recommended way to expose an API and shines for internal backends. Besides RPC, the same server serves plain Endpoint/@HttpMatcher handlers and health/metrics, the client is an extended java.net.http with listeners, routing and replay, and tracing bridges both sides. Modules JSON-RPC - JSON-RPC 2.
